title: USAID formerly headquartered at 1300 Pennsylvania Avenue NW
summary: Public government evidence supports the Ronald Reagan Building address as USAID's historical Washington headquarters. The relation is explicitly time-bounded and is not promoted to a current headquarters claim.

sources.title: Office of Inspector General Student Internship Program
